decision: Сохранить mainnet guest: локальная блокировка, восстановление журнала и явно описанное остаточное окно риска
scope: Configured V7 self-hosted worker, its retained independent original EOA journal and original SDK proving/publication boundaries
guarantees: Detected Core tips are retained before branch retrieval
Processed linked branch witnesses survive worker restarts and fresh directories with the original EOA lane
A known >100 fork or incomplete bounded witness blocks new worker proving/publication independently of a competing EVM anchor
Observation-to-queue outbox preserves original need IDs, scopes and local deadlines
Bounded own-funded maintenance jobs use original budgets; private paid requests cannot silently renew deadlines or funding
residual_risks: Events while every independent observer is unavailable may never have been observed
A local hash chain is not a proof of completeness of never-published history
A competing submitter can publish an accepted transition before this worker publishes a halt; an older EVM anchor may hide the observed deep fork
Independent consumers/submitters do not inherit this local fence on chain; Fresh and a current Bitcoin branch alone do not prove absence of hidden historical reorgs
Loss of every independent observation backup/checkpoint cannot be detected from the final Bitcoin/EVM branch alone
Missing witnesses, bounded history gaps or exhausted storage require recovery; no automatic reset/rebase clears the restriction
